verdict.rationale: Clerk documents default admin/member Roles plus custom Roles and fine-grained Permissions (clerk-docs-4, clerk-docs-46). It provides the Organization context, including memberships, Roles and the Active Organization, in each session (clerk-docs-24, clerk-docs-34), and its session token is a JWT carrying user and session information (clerk-docs-6). Enforcement is shown for gating eve tool calls against the caller's permissions (clerk-docs-16), though a community user notes roles are tied to Organizations rather than stored on the user (clerk-comm-3). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that role/permission claims appear in the session JWT, documented general-purpose authorization-check helpers, user-level (non-Organization) roles, and independent hands-on corroboration.
